en: High risk rite. Qualified odds are 39% auspicious / 60% neutral / 1% ominous; unqualified odds are 25% / 65% / 10%. An auspicious result grants Mandate +12 Authority +6 Prestige +8 and +2 yearly for five years; an ominous result reverses these effects.

cz: 低成本常礼。合格时吉15% 平75% 凶10%；不合格时吉5% 平70% 凶25%。吉兆天命+8 皇权+4 威望+5且五年每年+1；凶兆天命-8 皇权-4 威望-4且五年每年-1。
en: Lower cost rite. Qualified odds are 15% auspicious / 75% neutral / 10% ominous; unqualified odds are 5% / 70% / 25%. An auspicious result grants Mandate +8 Authority +4 Prestige +5 and +1 yearly for five years; an ominous result applies Mandate -8 Authority -4 Prestige -4 and -1 yearly.
ch: 低成本常禮。合格時吉15% 平75% 兇10%；不合格時吉5% 平70% 兇25%。吉兆天命+8 皇權+4 威望+5且五年每年+1；兇兆天命-8 皇權-4 威望-4且五年每年-1。

cz: 高投入谨慎行礼且不会出现凶兆。合格时吉50% 平50%；不合格时吉40% 平60%。吉兆天命+6 皇权+3 威望+4且五年每年+1；平兆天命+2 皇权+1 威望+1。
en: Costly cautious rite with no ominous outcome. Qualified odds are 50% auspicious / 50% neutral; unqualified odds are 40% / 60%. An auspicious result grants Mandate +6 Authority +3 Prestige +4 and +1 yearly for five years; a neutral result grants Mandate +2 Authority +1 Prestige +1.
